ch03.before: Because the united-front work toward both Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng
ch03.alt: Eleven men in long gowns and military uniforms stand in a row on open ground before a large earthen mound, the tomb rising behind them.
ch03.caption: In the summer of 1936, with North China in crisis, Chiang Kai-shek set the outside threat aside for the civil war; in October he came to Xi'an himself to force Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng to attack the Red Army in northern Shaanxi. Here Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng accompany Chiang Kai-shek on a visit to Maoling, the tomb of Emperor Wu of Han, in Xingping County. Third from the right is Yang Hucheng, sixth Zhang Xueliang, seventh Chiang Kai-shek, tenth Feng Qinzai, eleventh Shao Lizi. (The caption is the source's own.)
